steps.en: Run the OpenFGA server (in-memory to try it; PostgreSQL or MySQL in production)
steps.zh: 启动 OpenFGA 服务（试用放内存，生产接数据库）

steps.en: Write the authorization model: object types and how each relation is derived
steps.zh: 写授权模型：有哪些对象类型，每种关系怎么推导出来
steps.code: define can_read: viewer or owner or viewer from parent

steps.en: Whenever ownership, membership or sharing changes in your app, write a relationship tuple
steps.zh: 应用里所有权、成员或分享一变，就写一条关系元组

steps.en: Stores the tuples in its database alongside the versioned model
steps.zh: 把元组和带版本的模型一起存进它的数据库

steps.en: Before a protected action — or to build a list — the app asks the API
steps.zh: 受保护操作之前、或要列出可见对象时，应用调用它的 API

steps.en: Walks the relation graph through groups and parents and returns allowed or the object list
steps.zh: 沿着群组、上级目录等关系图查找，返回是否允许或对象列表

value.en: Sharing, groups and nested folders are decided by one service from one model, not by join-heavy SQL in every app
value.zh: 分享、群组、多层文件夹都由同一个服务按同一个模型判断，不再在每个应用里写多表联查

sources: https://github.com/openfga/openfga#quickstart (docker run -p 8080:8080 -p 3000:3000 openfga/openfga run; Write Authorization Model, Write Relationship Tuples, Perform Authorization Checks)
https://github.com/openfga/sample-stores/blob/main/stores/gdrive/model.fga (define can_read: viewer or owner or viewer from parent)
https://github.com/openfga/cli#readme (fga tuple write user:anne can_view document:roadmap; fga query check / list-objects)
https://github.com/openfga/openfga#production-readiness (PostgreSQL 14+, MySQL 8; memory adapter for development only)
